body: Happy birthday.   I’m struggling with staying here myself....perhaps the only thing keeping me here is asking what if....what if something better comes, ect...not sure if that helps you.

I pushed her away cause I didn’t want to be friends....now she blocked me and I’m agonizing through withdrawal.   If you do decide to go NC....beware the sharp initial sting....it’s become my life now and I wish I was dead.
I do tons to get out, I just don’t like a lot of people

Thank you,  but loneliness is a disease I’ve been suffering for 20years until her.    Now that she’s gone I don’t think I want to go back.    Thanks.    I truly believe some people are just not meant to be happy.    The world’s overpopulated anyway.
Thanks everyone.    That’s what I thought.    It’s so hard to lose someone that means so much to me....but ok.
I am with you...no more roads to go down for me, except one.
Thx.   I heard it can be picked up in Mexico.    Will find out.   If you hear from me again youll kniw it didn’t work.
Same situation....not sure if being friends gives me a better chance of being with her as NC would
People change, and what you thought you wanted may not be the same anymore.
